events.name: Cincinnati Open
events.summary: A combined ATP Masters 1000 and WTA 1000 tournament, with both draws, daily schedules, rankings and followed-player controls in one place.
details: Community Weekend opened the tournament on 8-9 August before main-draw play began on 11 August.
The event concludes with finals weekend on 22-23 August. Published match times remain subject to the official order of play.

events.name: US Open 2026
events.venue: USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center
events.summary: The final Grand Slam of 2026 runs for 22 days, from Fan Week and qualifying through the singles finals at Arthur Ashe Stadium.
details: Fan Week begins on 23 August and main-draw singles begin on 30 August.
The women's singles final is scheduled for 12 September and the men's singles final for 13 September.

events.name: 2026 Toyota AFL Finals Series
events.summary: The expanded 2026 Toyota AFL Finals Series opens with Wildcard Finals before the top-eight premiership race concludes at the MCG.
details: Wildcard Finals open the series: seventh plays 10th and eighth plays ninth, while the top six receive a bye into the first full week of finals.
The AFL will publish clubs, venues and kick-off times as the ladder and final-series pathway resolve.
The Grand Final is confirmed for Saturday 26 September at 2.30pm AEST at the MCG.
No exact public seller endpoint is published in this catalogue, so the card does not display a ticket CTA.

details: Australia v New Zealand opens the men's tournament at Allianz Stadium on 15 October.
The men's and women's finals are scheduled for Suncorp Stadium on 15 November.

events.name: UEFA Champions League 2026/27
events.summary: Europe's leading club competition runs through the 2026/27 season and concludes at Estadio Metropolitano in Madrid on 5 June 2027.
details: The league phase runs across eight matchdays from September 2026 to January 2027.
The knockout phase begins with play-offs in February, followed by the Round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals.
The Final is scheduled at Estadio Metropolitano, Madrid. Qualifiers, drawn ties and individual kick-off times remain source-published before they can be added to Fixtures.
No exact public seller endpoint is verified for the final, so the card does not display a ticket CTA.
